notes.title: fixed something from the last update
notes.notes:
Couldn't select time attack in World 2 without having beaten all levels, the new world map selection was not meant to have this still in tact

Added a level to caleb mode

notes.title: New update, added some cool stuff
notes.notes:
While watching people play, I've noticed they struggle at first with the world maps. It was a little janky so a menu pop up has been added to make things smoother.

Slightly changed the background in Profit City and 3-1.

No new levels added to Caleb Mode this time, this will be fixed later.

notes.title: New patch, made something slightly easier
notes.notes:
Changed the Time Attack mode for the first phase of the final boss, it used to require a speedrun trick that not many people knew about

Added two more levels to Caleb Mode

notes.title: New patch, needed to fix a thing
notes.notes:
A friend and I were talking about the special main menu screens so I went in the game files and realized some would appear and the wrong day and fixed that.

I also added two more levels to caleb mode and a special thing for getting through it.

notes.title: Another patch, fixed a glitched, changed a thing
notes.notes:
[list]
[*]Made Time Attack Mode not accessible until after the first world has been cleared. I noticed that players would sometimes accidentally activate it and then be confused why they couldn't enter levels.
[*]Fixed a glitch where upon entering a world map, a direction would need to be tapped once before being able to move.
[*]Added two more levels to Caleb Mode.
[/list]

notes.title: Surprise Patch Fixed a Thing
notes.notes:
[list]
[*]Fixed a background 
[*]Fixed a few instances of sprites being drawn in front of each other in the wrong order
[*]Added a few more playable levels to caleb mode
[/list]
